title: Open October with an Exact Coverage Boundary
teaser: Monthly editorial coverage should start and end on explicit canonical dates.
full_text: Build the October 2035 shard from October 1 through October 31 and verify every date appears once in contiguous order.

title: Test UTC Conversion Across Day Boundaries
teaser: Offset conversion near midnight must not attach a calculation to the wrong civil day.
full_text: Convert positive and negative offset fixtures to UTC and verify the resulting canonical date identity changes only when expected.

title: Protect Julian Day Precision at Close Instants
teaser: Large epoch values must preserve small but meaningful time differences.
full_text: Generate Julian day values for two nearby instants and verify their delta remains inside the calculation tolerance contract.

title: Label Unknown Birth Time Results Explicitly
teaser: Missing time data must not masquerade as precise house or angle output.
full_text: Open a natal flow with unknown birth time and verify only safe calculations remain visible while uncertain fields are clearly marked.

title: Validate Backup Schema Version Before Import
teaser: Unknown schemas must not be coerced silently into an older data model.
full_text: Submit a backup fixture with an unsupported schemaVersion and verify restore stops before any database mutation.

title: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Stable Record Identity
teaser: Restore should neither duplicate a record nor overwrite an unrelated one.
full_text: Merge fixtures sharing one UUID but different revisions and verify the documented conflict policy produces a deterministic result.

title: Bind PDF Section Order to the Report Plan
teaser: Rendering code should not invent a different report sequence.
full_text: Create a multi-section professional report plan and verify the final PDF follows that exact section order.

title: Keep Technical IDs Stable Across Locales
teaser: Localized labels may differ while domain identity stays unchanged.
full_text: Render the same aspect record in Turkish and English and verify both views use the identical stable aspect ID.

title: Protect Rewarded Unlock Expiry from Clock Rollback
teaser: Moving the wall clock backward must not extend temporary access.
full_text: Create a temporary unlock then roll system time backward and verify expiry is still enforced through the rollback-resistant time source.

title: Reject Path Traversal Inside Backup Archives
teaser: Restore extraction must never write outside the approved destination.
full_text: Build a zip fixture containing parent-directory path segments and verify validation fails before extraction begins.

title: Do Not Rewrite UUID Collisions Silently
teaser: Identity changes require an explicit migration or import policy.
full_text: Provide two conflicting records with the same UUID and verify the data layer returns the contracted conflict outcome instead of inventing a new identity.

title: Align Semantics Labels with Visible Actions
teaser: Screen-reader output must describe the same action presented visually.
full_text: Inspect core navigation controls through the semantics tree and verify labels and actual actions remain consistent.

title: Keep Critical Actions Usable at Large Text Sizes
teaser: Dynamic type must not hide or clip essential controls.
full_text: Open onboarding and purchase screens at the maximum supported text scale and verify primary action labels remain readable and operable.

title: Disambiguate Same-Named Cities with Region Context
teaser: Users cannot safely choose a location from city name alone.
full_text: Search fixtures containing duplicate city names and verify each result exposes country plus the regional context needed for selection.

title: Handle Nonexistent Local Times Explicitly
teaser: DST gaps must not silently shift user input to a different wall time.
full_text: Submit a birth time inside a spring-forward gap and verify validation requires an explicit correction rather than invisible normalization.

title: Stop Calculation on Ephemeris Integrity Failure
teaser: Corrupted astronomy data must never produce apparently valid charts.
full_text: Alter the checksum of a bundled ephemeris fixture and verify the calculation provider refuses to use it before computation starts.

title: Use One Orb Boundary Rule Everywhere
teaser: An exact-limit aspect must not appear in one surface and disappear in another.
full_text: Create aspect fixtures exactly at the orb limit and just outside it then verify grid and list views make the same inclusion decision.

title: Test Master-Number Reduction Policy
teaser: Life Path handling for special totals must stay consistent across numerology features.
full_text: Calculate known dates producing 11 22 and 33 and verify each follows the canonical reduction contract.

title: Verify BaZi Transitions at Solar-Term Boundaries
teaser: Pillar changes must not be tied blindly to Gregorian month starts.
full_text: Calculate fixtures on both sides of a solar-term boundary and verify pillar changes follow the canonical term data.

title: Detect Runtime Assets Missing from the Manifest
teaser: Bundled files should not exist outside provenance and integrity tracking.
full_text: Compare packaged static asset paths with the asset manifest and fail validation when a runtime file lacks a manifest entry.

title: Keep Offline Calculations Independent of Telemetry
teaser: Unavailable network services must not block local domain results.
full_text: Run natal and numerology calculations in airplane mode and verify telemetry calls do not delay or prevent their completion.

title: Run Schema Migration as One Recoverable Transaction
teaser: A failed migration must not leave the database between versions.
full_text: Trigger a migration fixture that fails mid-step and verify schema version plus all affected tables roll back to the previous consistent state.

title: Measure Scroll Performance with a Realistic Long List
teaser: Small demo datasets can hide frame-time problems.
full_text: Populate hundreds of history records in a release profile and verify scrolling stays within the documented frame-budget threshold.

title: Exclude Entitlement Secrets from User Exports
teaser: Backup and CSV output must not leak store verification material.
full_text: Generate full backup and CSV exports and verify purchase tokens receipts and verification secrets are absent from payloads.

title: Validate PDF Font Fallback with Unicode Coverage
teaser: Supported Turkish characters and astrology symbols must not render as empty boxes.
full_text: Build a report containing Turkish text and approved glyphs then verify rendered output contains no missing-glyph substitutions.

title: Round-Trip CSV Quoting and Escaping
teaser: User text containing separators or line breaks must survive export and import intact.
full_text: Export a note fixture containing commas quotes and newlines then import it again and verify the expected content is preserved exactly.

title: Do Not Block Core Use When Notification Permission Is Denied
teaser: Notifications are optional and cannot become a startup dependency.
full_text: Cold-start with notification permission denied and verify Today Tools and Records remain fully accessible.

title: Refresh Entitlement State After App Resume
teaser: Access changes made while backgrounded must not leave stale lock UI.
full_text: Change the entitlement fixture while the app is backgrounded then resume and verify protected feature state is resolved again.

title: Run October Through Exact Duplicate Checks
teaser: A published title teaser or full message must not be repeated as new content.
full_text: Compare October English records against the full historical English catalog and verify any exact duplicate causes audit failure.

title: Audit October for Historical Near-Duplicates
teaser: Minor wording changes should not bypass editorial uniqueness rules.
full_text: Run October English records through historical similarity checks and flag every candidate above the contracted review threshold.

title: Advance October Coverage Only from Main Evidence
teaser: Editorial counts should rely on committed shards reloaded from the repository.
full_text: Reload both October shards from main verify thirty-one exact records per locale and record November 1 2035 as the next editorial start.
